intro: The market history Atlas keeps on this Mac for its agents: candles, funding and open interest from OKX.

title.done: Market history is up to date

sub.done: <f>{{n}}</f> instruments, <f>{{bars}}</f> bars and <f>{{size}}</f> on this Mac.
sub.paused: Paused at {{pct}}: {{written}} of {{expected}} bars. Resume picks up where it stopped.
sub.stalled: No new bars for <f>{{mins}}</f> minutes. The trading service may have stopped; check it with <cmd>./atlas status</cmd>.

resyncTip: Fetches anything missing since the last run, and the history of newly listed instruments.
legendNote: One square per instrument. It fills as its history arrives.
keeping: Atlas adds each new bar as it closes and checks recent bars every 15 minutes.
pausedNote: Nothing is being fetched. Bars that close while paused are fetched when you resume.

failed.body: OKX returned errors for {{list}}. Atlas stopped those jobs; the rest carry on.

limited.title: Re-sync already requested
limited.body: Atlas takes one re-sync a minute. Try again shortly.

down.title: Couldn’t reach the trading service
down.body: Nothing started. Check that Atlas is running with <cmd>./atlas up</cmd>, then try again.
down.plain: Nothing started. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.

toast.pausedBody: Resume picks up where it stopped.
toast.startedBody: Atlas is fetching history for every instrument.
toast.limited: Re-sync already requested. Try again shortly.

depth.open: As far back as OKX goes

q.title: Data quality
q.note: Atlas checks recent bars every 15 minutes and fetches missing bars again from OKX. Outliers and zero-volume bars are logged and kept exactly as OKX reported them.
q.notRepairedTip: Atlas asks OKX again on every check. If OKX has no bars for this window, the gap stays open.
q.duplicateTip: Atlas keeps one bar for each time and logs the extra copy.
q.outlierTip: Atlas never deletes an outlier. The bar stays exactly as OKX reported it.
q.zeroTip: Stock perps trade thinly outside US hours, so bars with no trades are expected.
q.noneOpen: No open issues. The last check found nothing to fix.

k.title: What Atlas keeps
k.candlesSub: Six bar sizes for every instrument

i.title: Instruments
i.order: Same order as the map: by asset class, then instrument ID.
i.noneBody: Search by instrument ID, for example BTC-USDT-SWAP.
i.noneFilterBody: Choose All to see every instrument.

sh.label: Market history of {{inst}}
sh.subDone: {{cls}}. All of its history is in.
sh.noIssues: No issues found on this instrument.

empty.title: No market history yet
empty.body: Atlas fetches candles, funding and open interest for every instrument in the OKX demo universe, so its agents can work from history. The first run can take a few hours, and you can pause it at any time.

error.title: Couldn’t load the data status
error.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with <cmd>./atlas up</cmd>, then try again.
